data.raw_text:
Former commander of AFP Southern Luzon Antonio Parlade posted a comment on a PGMN social media post, where he made statements about IBON Foundation and linked the group to the Communist Party of the Philippines.

In his comment, Parlade described IBON as part of what he called a “propaganda machinery” of the CPP and said the group promotes Marxist thought and influences public discourse through its analysis and narratives. He also referenced Salugpungan schools, including ALCADEV, TRIFPSS, and CLANS, stating that these institutions use materials produced by IBON. He further mentioned foreign donors and solidarity groups in connection with these activities, and ended his comment by rejecting IBON’s position.

The comment appeared under a PGMN post featuring PGMN Anchor Orion Perez Dumdum, which discussed the proposed wealth tax associated with IBON’s policy position and its potential impact on assets linked to businessman Ramon Ang and companies like San Miguel Corporation.

Watch the full breakdown by Orion Perez Dumdum here: 
https://t.co/zCaKhQo20u
